connector.name: Phano Intelligence Platform
connector.registryDescription: Read-only account intelligence for Customer Success and Account Management teams.
connector.summary: Hosted at phano.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.phano, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: your Phano API key, created in Phano under Settings then API keys.
